title: AG1 Supplement Email – Product Education Layout
description:
This email design focuses on product education through clean structure and benefit-led storytelling. Created for wellness, supplement, and lifestyle brands, the layout breaks down complex information into digestible visual sections—combining ingredient highlights, routine integration, and lifestyle imagery.

The pacing helps customers understand why the product matters before asking them to purchase. Clear CTAs, modular content blocks, and science-meets-lifestyle visuals make this format ideal for brands selling habit-based or subscription products.

It’s designed to build trust first, conversion second—perfect for wellness brands that rely on long-term customer relationships rather than impulse buys.
